changeSet.author: pconrad
changeSet.comment: lib-jobs v0.2.0 backfill (1/2): copy existing JOBS.LOG text into a staging column before the lib-jobs library changelog drops JOBS.LOG and creates JOB_LOGS (see lib-jobs DESIGN.md 8). The library's own changeset creates JOB_LOGS and drops JOBS.LOG in one atomic changeSet, so the copy has to happen before it runs, not in between. LOG_BACKFILL is TEXT (not VARCHAR(1048576)) because production's JOBS.LOG column -- created by the old @Column(columnDefinition="TEXT", length=1048576) entity annotation, where columnDefinition wins and the length is only a JPA hint -- is an unbounded Postgres TEXT column, and at least one production job log exceeds 1,048,576 characters. See docs/liquibase.md incident writeup. validCheckSums covers any environment (e.g. QA) that already ran this changeset with the original VARCHAR(1048576) column type before that fix.

sql.sql: UPDATE JOBS SET LOG_BACKFILL = LOG WHERE LOG IS NOT NULL
